questions.prompt_en: The table shows the percentage of households owning their homes in three fictional cities in 2000, 2010 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
questions.prompt_vi: Select overview trends; compare three cities; use percentage points accurately.

answer.model_en:
The table compares the proportions of households that owned their homes in three cities in 2000, 2010 and 2020. All figures are given as percentages.

Overall, home ownership increased in Riverton and Lakeford, whereas it fell in Hillport. Although Hillport had the highest proportion at the beginning, Riverton became the leading city by the end of the period.

In 2000, 68% of households in Hillport owned their accommodation, compared with 55% in Lakeford and just 42% in Riverton. Ten years later, Hillport's figure had dropped slightly to 64%. Over the same period, Riverton rose by eight percentage points to 50%, while Lakeford experienced a smaller increase to 58%.

By 2020, Riverton had reached 61%, a total rise of 19 percentage points over the two decades. Lakeford also increased, but more gradually, to 60%. In contrast, the rate in Hillport declined further to 59%. As a result, the gap between the three cities was only two percentage points in the final year.
